observed_status_review.scope: Original operator release records inauguration of the developed NOI2 facility on its existing Noida campus. No current customer workloads, commissioning of all advertised capacity, NOI3 completion or whole-estate completion is inferred.

locator_review.property_identity: DLF subsidiary FY2025 accounts p56 notes 45/46 identify STT Data Centre 2 agreement at Plot 1 and the commercial leasehold estate at Plot 01 Sector 143A. locator_review.source_scope: The UP-RERA accountant certificate concerns mixed IT Block A, Data Centre Block B and open parking. It is a private filing hosted by the regulator, not a government survey. Its text describes 33,310 m², while the four endpoints enclose approximately 106,990 m². The landlord describes a 24.774-acre estate; the operator DC1 factsheet describes about 5 acres. These extents are not interchangeable.

rejected_derived_reference.source_crs: Geographic latitude and longitude; datum, realization and epoch unspecified by source. No datum correction claimed.
rejected_derived_reference.method: Equal arithmetic mean of four published endpoint longitude values and separately latitude values; axis reordering; round to seven decimal places. This is a compiled mixed-estate reference, not an official centroid.
rejected_derived_reference.area_limit: Connecting cardinal endpoint observations is a diagnostic only. Its area differs from the stated first-phase area; no polygon, surveyed boundary, phase footprint, parcel size, current area or distance bound is selected.
unknowns: exact extent of phase and campus

locator_review.forbidden_substitutes: No directory, map-app, OSM or city centroid supplies replacement geometry.

holds.identity_review: The operator handbook explicitly gives the physical site address Continuity House, 205 Torrington Avenue, CV4 9UT. No blanket commercial-reuse prohibition is inferred for all council data; the separate open-data page states OGL for its designated datasets. No planning-map coordinate is selected.
locator_findings.rejected_sources: Directory coordinates, IP geolocation, postcode points and map-app coordinates were not selected. No OSM request was made.

holds.successor_review: Original current 50-incident feed and current facility page reviewed through November 11. Later PHP security advisory is not new physical hosting evidence. Regional network and replacement plans are not treated as whole-site closure or completed migrations.
holds.required_followup: Original operator coordinate, exact public-authority address/UPRN join to an eligible open numeric point, or exact named-site planning/permit location; then full-geometry proximity review.

holds.candidate: Telxius Cancun Landing Gateway & Edge Data Center
holds.reason: The original September 3 release establishes a built facility ready for customers, but no precise facility-level locator was established. The operator network map supplies a named data-centre point with exactly the same geometry as a generic Cancun PoP; its inverse-projected coordinates are rounded to 0.01 degree and no site address or parcel is supplied. The reviewed sources do not establish whether this is a generalized network node or the actual physical host. No new site is admitted from that uncertainty.

observed_status_review.date_semantics: Explicit original publication and dateline describe the facility as built and ready to support customers. This supports completion, without treating customer readiness as proof of equipment in operation. The separate Tikal cable launch remains a future first-half-2027 target.
observed_status_review.later_context: The undated new-PoPs page describes commercial facilities and services; it does not create a later dated physical observation. No capacity or operating workload is selected.

locator_review.operator_chain: The original Telxius page links mapainteractivo.telxius.com. Its bootstrap loads index-8a695de0.js, which names the public ArcGIS service Mapa_publico and the telxius.maps.arcgis.com portal. ArcGIS item1dc66cc8d6fb48d5a0aadec3e2e842c7 is owned by Telxius.
locator_review.scope_limit: This network reference is not established as a precise building, entrance or parcel. No metropolitan marker, beach manhole or cable landing point is substituted for the data centre.
locator_review.fcc_context: Original FCC June 2025 license summary identifies a new Cancun cable landing station but says the precise location will be furnished once real estate is acquired; that document supplies no Cancun station coordinate. No cable authorization is treated as permission for the data-centre development or a physical opening.

identity_review.nearby_review: Not used for admission because the candidate coordinate has unresolved physical scope. No comparison using this coarse reference is claimed to establish a new exact host.

holds.next_evidence: An operator, developer, landlord or public-authority address/parcel/coordinate explicitly locating the physical TCAN01/Cancun facility, or an updated original FCC station-location filing with a demonstrable facility identity join.
